intro.en: Antal is a young Savra in Endfield's Operations Team Z7 who works as a supporter and Originium technology consultant, gifted in Originium Arts though he often misreads social cues.
intro.zh-TW: 安塔爾是終末地 Z7 行動組的年輕薩弗拉成員，擔任輔助與源石技術顧問，源石技藝天賦出眾卻不擅察言觀色。

basic.en: Electric combo of up to 4 hits. His Final Strike deals 15 Stagger while he is the controlled operator.
basic.zh-TW: 最多 4 段的電磁傷害連擊。作為主控幹員時，重擊造成 15 點失衡。

battle.en: He deals Electric damage and applies a long-lasting Focus to at most 1 enemy at a time, inflicting Electric Susceptibility and Heat Susceptibility while Focus lasts.
battle.zh-TW: 對敵人造成電磁傷害並施加長時間聚焦，使目標同時承受電磁脆弱與灼熱脆弱；同一時間最多聚焦 1 個敵人。

combo.en: Trigger: an enemy with Focus suffers a Physical Status or Arts Infliction. He sets off 1 energy blast on that enemy for Electric damage and applies another stack of the same Physical Status or Arts Infliction.
combo.zh-TW: 觸發條件：被聚焦的敵人進入物理異常或法術附著狀態。在該敵人身上引發 1 次能量爆炸，造成電磁傷害並再次施加相同的物理異常或法術附著。

ultimate.en: He grants temporary Electric Amp and Heat Amp to the whole team.
ultimate.zh-TW: 為全隊施加一段時間的電磁增幅與灼熱增幅。

talents.en: When an Amped teammate deals skill damage, Antal heals that teammate for 72 + Strength × 0.6 HP (108 + Strength × 0.9 at Promotion II), at most 1 time every 30 s per operator.
talents.zh-TW: 處於增幅狀態的隊友造成技能傷害後，安塔爾為其回復 72 + 力量 × 0.6 點生命值（精英化II 為 108 + 力量 × 0.9），每名幹員每 30 秒最多觸發 1 次。

talents.en: He has a 30% chance to negate Physical damage and restore 27 + Strength × 0.23 HP to himself (45 + Strength × 0.38 at Promotion III).
talents.zh-TW: 有 30% 機率免疫物理傷害，並回復自身 27 + 力量 × 0.23 點生命值（精英化III 為 45 + 力量 × 0.38）。

potentials.en: Overclocked Moment's Electric Amp and Heat Amp effects increase to 1.1 times their original values.
potentials.zh-TW: 超頻時刻提供的電磁增幅與灼熱增幅效果提升為原本的 1.1 倍。

potentials.en: Overclocked Moment costs 10% less Ultimate Energy.
potentials.zh-TW: 超頻時刻所需的終結技能量 -10%。

potentials.en: Returns 15 SP when an enemy with Focus is defeated while Focus lasts.
potentials.zh-TW: 被聚焦的敵人於聚焦期間遭到擊敗時，返還 15 點技力。

potentials.en: Keeping Focus on the same enemy for 20 s increases its Electric Susceptibility and Heat Susceptibility by 4%.
potentials.zh-TW: 對同一目標維持聚焦達 20 秒後，電磁脆弱與灼熱脆弱效果再提高 4%。
